meta.purpose: Answer key for artifact_org-a_proj-a1.md — the findings a good reviewer (and the agent) should produce. Used to measure recall/precision.

expected_findings.evidence: The nightly Reporting job reads directly from the Payment Orchestrator's database instead of via a published API.
The Payment Orchestrator (business-critical) is deployed to a single availability zone, with no redundancy.
No backup or recovery approach is documented for the restricted Customer Datastore.
Payment Orchestrator service accounts are granted admin-level database rights, violating least privilege.
Checkout API is stated to sit behind the enterprise WAF.
Personal data is kept in the approved EU region only.
